context.body: The bounded canonical source is Ezekiel 37:15–28; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Two sticks labeled for Judah and Joseph become one in the prophet’s hand, and the interpretation promises one nation, one king, cleansing, covenant of peace, sanctuary, and God’s dwelling.
observations.label: Judah and Joseph become one stick: action

observations.body: divided identities are reunited but not erased from the sign.
observations.label: Judah and Joseph become one stick: response

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 37:15–28 as prophets accuse and promise evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The symbol begins with two named houses and ends with one people under one ruler.
payload.title: Judah and Joseph become one stick
